releaseMeaning: Candidate audit reads current evidence and explains what can be reviewed next. It does not create, approve, sync, publish, or satisfy operating proof.

lanes.title: Approved Discord knowledge
lanes.adminSurface: /admin/discord -> Content Queue, Drafts, and Knowledge Candidate review panels
blockers: No pending knowledge candidates are available for admin review.
Capture real member questions, helpful answers, builds, reviews, wins, or resources before approving knowledge.
lanes.nextReviewAction: Approve high-signal questions, answers, resources, wins, reviews, or drafts from /admin/discord.
lanes.provingCommand: npm run discord:operating-cycle:dry-run && npm run discord:proof-backlog

lanes.title: Discord knowledge synced into RAG
lanes.adminSurface: /admin/discord -> RAG Health, Corpus Health, and Eval Runs panels
blockers: No approved Discord knowledge exists to sync into authoritative RAG.
Latest RAG sync did not upsert approved Discord sources.
lanes.nextReviewAction: Run the approved Discord RAG sync after approving knowledge candidates.
lanes.provingCommand: npm run discord:operating-cycle && npm run rag:evaluate && npm run discord:smoke-final-scorecard

lanes.title: Public proof growth assets
lanes.adminSurface: /admin/discord -> Public Proof Sources and Public Growth Drafts panels
blockers: Public proof drafts require approved Discord source material first.
Dry run does not create public proof drafts.
lanes.nextReviewAction: Create privacy-safe public proof drafts from approved Discord source material and approve/publish them weekly.
lanes.provingCommand: npm run discord:operating-cycle && npm run discord:proof-backlog

lanes.title: Premium workflow proof
lanes.adminSurface: /admin/discord -> Premium, Office Hours, and Member Intelligence panels
blockers: No premium member or deliberately seeded premium scenario is visible in current evidence.
Premium proof must show authorization, request/SLA state, and fulfillment outcome together.
lanes.nextReviewAction: Run one premium review, deeper-answer, or office-hours flow with a real or intentionally seeded premium scenario.
lanes.provingCommand: npm run discord:smoke-premium-workflows && npm run discord:proof-backlog
